items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Peggy Lee, see when I was in the Le Ruban Bleu, Dave Barber with whom she married was the guitar player. Of course Peggy would be in the club quite often.

ctx.x: Whether she was a jazz singer or not, I like to think of singers as being stylists, you know. You can distinguish between Billie Holiday and say a pop singer, Ella Fitzgerald, Peggy Lee, Mildred Bailey, when Mildred was alive.
Now these are pop singers you're listing.
